title: the Ninefold Court Rising
premise: Theo Dunmore survives in the memoryless valley of Hollowmere by stealing recollections from travelers and selling them back to the grieving. When a dying courier presses a map into his hands, Theo learns the valley's magic-dead silence is a wound: the Ninefold Court that once bound the realms has been shattered, and its nine regalia must be gathered before the thirteenth moon turns or the boundary between worlds collapses. Hunted by the Court's usurper, the Ashen Regent, Theo is forced beyond the valley he never left, discovering that his own stolen memories hold the key to the covenant's reforging. In the end, Theo sacrifices his hoarded memories—including those of the mother he never knew—to reforge the Ninefold Court, choosing belonging among strangers over the safety of forgetting.
about_author: Yara Sterling is a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing oral histories from border towns before turning to fantasy. She writes about outsiders and broken bargains from a farmhouse full of maps she refuses to throw away.

chapters.title: The Weight of Borrowed Things
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. He works Hollowmere's market, lifting memories from travelers and selling them back at a markup, careful never to take too much. A routine job goes wrong when a stranger recognizes what Theo is. Emotional beat: the loneliness beneath Theo's competence, and the first crack in his invisibility.

chapters.title: A Stranger Dying at the Door
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. The stranger—wounded, silver-eyed—collapses in Theo's loft and presses a folded map into his hands, whispering 'thirteen turns' before dying. The map burns cold and won't leave Theo's skin. Emotional beat: terror and reluctant responsibility as Theo realizes the valley's wards just failed for the first time in living memory.

chapters.title: What the Valley Cannot Hold
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo tries to destroy the map; it reappears. He interrogates the town's oldest resident, Maren, who reveals fragments: the valley was founded by exiles fleeing the Court's last war. Emotional beat: the vertigo of learning your home is a hiding place, not a haven.

chapters.title: The First Mark
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Hunters wearing ash-grey sigils enter Hollowmere asking after a courier. Theo watches them erase a neighbor's memories wholesale and understands what the Regent's men do. Emotional beat: righteous fear hardening into resolve—he leaves at dawn rather than let them hollow his town.

chapters.title: Crossing the Threshold
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Beyond the valley, magic floods him—the map awakens, showing the first regalia site. He meets Sefa, a disgraced Court knight turned caravan guard, who recognizes the map and nearly kills him for it. Emotional beat: disorientation and wonder, then wary alliance born of mutual need.

chapters.title: The Bridge of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa explains the Ninefold Covenant: nine regents, nine regalia, one binding law—and her own desertion the night the Ashen Regent seized three seats. She agrees to guide Theo only to settle a debt. Emotional beat: guilt worn as armor, and the beginning of trust neither will name.

chapters.title: The Lantern of Unkept Promises
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. At a drowned chapel they retrieve the first regalia, a lantern holding oaths never fulfilled. Touching it floods Theo with a stranger's broken vows—including one made by a woman with his mother's voice. Emotional beat: grief for a past he can't verify, hunger for more.

chapters.title: Market of Stolen Years
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. In the free city of Vell, Theo finds a black market where memories are currency—and discovers someone has been selling memories of his mother for years. He buys one and hears her name him aloud. Emotional beat: joy curdling into suspicion; the seller knew the dying stranger.

chapters.title: The Regent's Summons
chapters.summary: Ashen Regent's POV. The Regent, once the Court's ninth seat, explains her creed: the covenant was slavery dressed as justice, and she broke it to free the realms—even as her erasure-hunters unmake dissenters. Emotional beat: chilling conviction; the villain who believes she is the cure.

chapters.title: Ash on the Road
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Ambushed by erasure-hunters, Sefa takes a partial wipe meant for Theo and loses her memory of why she deserted. Theo uses his theft-gift to steal the hunters' orders instead of their minds. Emotional beat: Theo's power used to protect rather than profit—a turning point in how he sees himself.

chapters.title: The Second Seat Remembers
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. They find the second regent alive but senile in a mountain hospice; her regalia, a ring, responds not to blood but to witnessed truth. Theo returns her stolen decades, briefly restoring her, and she names the Regent's true aim: not freedom, but a single throne. Emotional beat: awe at memory as an act of justice.

chapters.title: Thirteen Turns, Twelve Gone
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. With two regalia found and one moon remaining, the map reveals the rest are held in the Regent's citadel. Sefa, half-restored, confesses she helped the Regent rise before defecting. Emotional beat: betrayal and forgiveness tangled; the party fractures and reforms around shared purpose.

chapters.title: The City That Forgot Its Name
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. They pass through a city the Regent erased entirely—no records, no graves, only Theo can feel the residual memories in its stones. He spends days returning fragments to survivors camped outside. Emotional beat: the cost of his gift made visible; he cannot save everyone, and chooses who.

chapters.title: Bargain at the Broken Court
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Seeking allies, they petition the three neutral regents at the ruined Court hall. One demands a price: Theo must surrender the memory of his mother's voice as proof of good faith. Emotional beat: sacrifice rehearsed—Theo pays, and hates how easily he does.

chapters.title: Infiltration of the Ashen Citadel
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Disguised as a memory-tithe collector, Theo enters the citadel where the Regent stores confiscated pasts in vaults. He finds six regalia guarded by a warden who is the dying stranger's twin sister. Emotional beat: tension and moral compromise—Theo lies fluently and no longer likes who he is here.

chapters.title: The Warden's Grief
chapters.summary: Warden Ilse's POV. Ilse guards the vaults believing her brother died a traitor; Theo carries his final memory and gives it to her freely, asking nothing. Shattered, she opens the vaults—or half of them—before alarms rise. Emotional beat: mercy as strategy and sincerity at once; the arc's moral thesis embodied.

chapters.title: Flight Through the Memory Vaults
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Pursued through corridors of bottled pasts, Theo grabs four regalia but the lantern slips free. Sefa holds the gate at terrible cost, fully losing her desertion-memory again. Emotional beat: desperate momentum; victory that feels like loss.

chapters.title: What the Regent Offered Me
chapters.summary: Regent's POV. Captured briefly, Theo is offered everything: his mother restored whole, his valley safe forever, if he hands over the map. The Regent shows him the covenant's original cruelty honestly. Emotional beat: genuine temptation; Theo refuses not because she lies, but because her peace requires erasing others.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Moon Rises
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. Escaped with five regalia, the company races to the Court's heart as the final moon rises. The neutral regents arrive; the missing pieces are the crown itself, held in the Regent's keeping, and the covenant-heart, which demands a willing sacrifice of memory. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into clarity—Theo has known since chapter seven what the reforging costs.

chapters.title: Climax: The Reforging
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. At the Court's heart, Theo faces the Regent and offers the alternative she never considered: not one throne, not nine masters, but a covenant renewed by consent—each regalia borne by choice. To seal it he surrenders every memory he owns, including his mother. The Court blazes back to life as the Regent's power unravels. Emotional beat: triumphant devastation; the climax where theme becomes act.

chapters.title: After the Light
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. The Regent, stripped of stolen authority, is judged by the renewed Court—not erased, but remembered, which proves worse. Sefa, offered her seat back, declines to serve and chooses to travel. Emotional beat: justice outside vengeance; the quiet aftermath of victory.

chapters.title: Hollowmere, Remembered
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Memoryless but not empty, Theo returns to the valley, where Maren and the townsfolk give his past back to him piece by piece—stories, not magic. Among them is a memory Sefa kept for him: his mother's voice saying his name. Emotional beat: belonging chosen and rebuilt; a close that answers the opening image.
